# hallpass_operator (Resource)

An operator: a person who signs in to the HallPass console. It is created without a password; link a single sign-on identity with `hallpass_operator_identity`, or send a password-reset link from the console. `roles` are the manually assigned roles; roles mapped from single sign-on groups are managed by the identity provider and shown in `sso_roles`. The provider's token cannot change the operator it acts for. HallPass never deletes operators (the audit log names them), so destroying the resource **disables** the operator and removes its manual roles; to manage it again, import it. Email and display name cannot be changed through the API. Import with the operator ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Signs in with the company SSO (see hallpass_operator_identity) and approves requests for the on-call group.
resource "hallpass_operator" "ada" {
  email        = "ada@example.com"
  display_name = "Ada Lovelace"
  roles        = ["approver", "viewer"]
  groups       = ["oncall"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the console and audit log (at most 128 bytes). Changing it forces a new operator.
- `email` (String) Email address (unique among operators). It is not used to match single sign-on accounts. Changing it forces a new operator.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the operator may sign in. Disabling ends their sessions and stops their API tokens. Defaults to `true`.
- `groups` (Set of String) Operator groups, used by approver rules. Defaults to none.
- `roles` (Set of String) Manually assigned roles: `administrator`, `approver`, `auditor`, `viewer`. Defaults to none.

### Read-Only

- `has_password` (Boolean) Whether the operator has set a password.
- `id` (String) Operator ID (`opr_…`).
- `sso_roles` (Set of String) Roles mapped from single sign-on groups (read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Operator ID
terraform import hallpass_operator.ada opr_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j
```
